name: nilLen_range_succ
source: private theorem nilLen_range_succ {A M : Type} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
show: For an endomorphism f of a module over a commutative ring and any natural k, the image of f raised to k+1 is the image under f of the range of fᵏ.
strategy: Apply f once more to the image obtained after k iterations. The general range formula for a composite gives the equality of submodules.

steps.claim: The image after k + 1 iterations is f applied to the image after k iterations. Indeed, the extra application sends each fᵏ(x) to f(fᵏ(x)), and fᵏ(x) runs through the entire image of fᵏ as x runs through M.
steps.snippet:
LinearMap.range (f ^ (k + 1)) = (LinearMap.range (f ^ k)).map f := by
  rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_eq_comp, LinearMap.range_comp]
